title: Doubting four funds, including Renaissance and D.E. Shaw

tellings.quote: It's like in the early 2000s I didn't believe the following four funds. Bernie Maidoff, Renaissance Technologies, De Shaw, and Jeff Epstein.

plain: In the early 2000s, the researcher Eric Weinstein says, he did not believe the stories told about four investment operations: those of Bernie Madoff and Jeffrey Epstein, and the funds Renaissance Technologies and D.E. Shaw. He tells it as his own past doubt, "I didn't believe the following four funds," to show that he has long been suspicious of how some fortunes were explained to the public.
